about: The Bridge redesign pitch, NIGHT PIECE design. Every image is AI-generated illustrative imagery: never The Bridge's store, staff, customers, products or brands, never a real place, never a real person. Ids are file names in assets/generated/ (jpg = backdrop, png = transparent cut-out). 'aspect' is the delivered aspect, 'gen' the aspect it was generated at (the model has no 4:5 or 2:1, so those are cropped). Each prompt is sent with the style line in defaults appended.

defaults.style: Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, no signage anywhere in the image. No people, no faces, no hands, no bodies, no animals.

images.alt: Section of black riveted steel bridge truss with an orange rim light
images.prompt: Close studio photograph of one massive section of old riveted steel bridge truss, seen at a slight three quarter angle and filling the whole width of the frame: two thick heavy riveted box chords running left to right, joined by big diagonal lattice members and heavy gusset plates with rows of large rivets, clear open gaps between the members, black weathered steel with rust texture. The beams are as thick as a person is tall, this is one huge industrial fragment, not a model and not a whole bridge. A hard orange rim light from the upper left traces every upper edge. Plain seamless dark charcoal grey background, evenly lit, no floor line, no cast shadow on the background. The cut ends of the beams are inside the frame. No stencils, no numbers.

images.alt: Three unbranded matte black spray cans with an orange rim light
images.prompt: Studio photograph of three identical plain matte black aerosol spray paint cans grouped together, one slightly in front of the other two, each a smooth blank cylinder with a black cap and a black nozzle, bare satin metal with no label, no printing, no stripes, no markings of any kind. A hard orange rim light from the upper left runs along the left edge and shoulder of each can, the rest of each can is dark but still readable. Plain seamless dark charcoal grey background, evenly lit, no floor line, no cast shadow on the background. All three cans whole in frame with margin on all sides.

images.prompt: A soft cloud of ultra fine orange aerosol spray paint hanging in still air, photographed like fog: a dense glowing centre thinning outward into a haze of microscopic droplets, very soft edges with no clumps, no beads, no powder lumps, on an absolutely pure black background, hard light from the upper left. The mist dissolves completely before it reaches the frame, all four edges of the frame are pure black. No can, no nozzle, nothing else in frame.

images.alt: Dark wall with faded spray paint in one hard shaft of orange light
images.prompt: Caravaggio tenebrism photograph: near-black ground, one single hard warm orange sodium key light from the upper left, deep shadow swallowing most of the frame, high-end fine art photographic finish. An extreme close view of a raw board-formed black concrete wall filling the entire frame, seen straight on. A narrow pool of hard orange light grazes across the surface from the upper left at a very low angle, so every pit, crack and rough grain throws a long tiny shadow, and beyond the pool the wall falls off into pure black. The concrete keeps barely visible worn ghost layers of very old spray paint, thin faded dull orange and dark cobalt fog worn into the pores, shapeless and illegible, no big painted shapes, no letterforms, no tags.
